g.text: View Order, Payment, and Delivery Status
Verify payment server-side; a redirect alone is not proof.
Book delivery only after payment succeeds. Pickup bypasses delivery.
Controlled Django administration, not vendor self-service.
Cash payment only for PICKUP orders in PENDING_PAYMENT;
Confirm pickup only for PICKUP orders already CONFIRMED;
skips PREPARING / READY_FOR_PICKUP; direct CONFIRMED -> COMPLETED.
